name: Lethargy
body:
This curse is most commonly found on sacred sites, affecting trespassing nonbelievers so that the faithful can more easily deal with their impious intrusions.

Type curse; Save Will DC 15; Frequency 1/day

EFFECTS

The victim always goes last in the initiative order, and he takes a –4 penalty on all Reflex saves.
